**Retail Construction Built for Business—Not Just Bricks & Mortar**  
*Rooster & Co. | Dallas-Fort Worth’s Trusted Retail Construction Partner*

In the fast-paced, competitive world of retail—where first impressions drive foot traffic, brand loyalty, and sales—your physical space isn’t just a location. It’s your most powerful salesperson. At Rooster & Co., we don’t just build retail spaces—we build *revenue-ready environments* tailored to the unique rhythm of the Dallas-Fort Worth market.

With deep roots in North Texas and decades of hands-on experience—from legacy strip centers in Plano to high-visibility mixed-use developments in Uptown Dallas and adaptive reuses in the Design District—we understand what makes retail *work* here:  
✅ **Speed without sacrifice** — Tight timelines are non-negotiable in retail. We deliver fast-track builds, phased openings, and weekend/after-hours construction to keep your grand opening on schedule—and your lease clock running *in your favor*.  
✅ **Local compliance, mastered** — Navigating DFW’s layered permitting (city, county, TxDOT for thoroughfares, ADA overlays, fire marshal inspections, and TREC/TCI requirements) isn’t a hurdle—it’s our daily workflow. We get approvals *right the first time*, so your project moves—not stalls.  
✅ **Retail-smart design-build collaboration** — Whether you’re a national brand expanding into Southlake, a beloved local boutique opening in Deep Ellum, or a quick-service concept scaling across the Metroplex, we partner early with your architects, vendors, and brand ops team to optimize layout, merchandising flow, MEP integration (think seamless POS power, refrigeration, high-bandwidth Wi-Fi), and customer experience—all while protecting your budget and brand integrity.  
✅ **Dallas-built resilience** — From storm-ready roofing in Garland to energy-efficient HVAC for Fort Worth’s sweltering summers, and moisture-managed slab systems for humid North Texas soil—we build smart, durable spaces that perform year after year.

**Why DFW Retailers Choose Rooster & Co.:**  
🔹 92% of our retail projects open on or ahead of schedule  
🔹 Fully licensed and insured general contractor—Texas-only, Texas-focused  
🔹 In-house preconstruction, estimating, and project management (no subcontracted coordination)  
🔹 Proven portfolio: Grocery-anchored centers in Irving, boutique strip malls in Frisco, infill retail in Dallas’ booming Oak Lawn corridor, and repositioned retail corridors in Arlington  

**Your store isn’t just going up—it’s launching.**  
Let Rooster & Co. handle the construction—so you can focus on building your brand, engaging your community, and growing your business across Dallas, Fort Worth, and the entire Metroplex.

*Ready to open doors—and opportunities?*  
📞 Call us today for a no-obligation site assessment and custom timeline estimate.  
📍 Serving Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Irving, Arlington, Frisco, McKinney, Richardson & beyond.

**Rooster & Co. — Building Retail That Sells.**  
*General Contractors • Retail Specialists • Dallas-Fort Worth Since 2003*
